declarations.name: defaultSwipeActions
declarations.description: The actions of a swipeable list that sets none: one red Delete, revealed from the end edge.

Presents consumer-owned direct children as one vertical list and lets users reorder movable items with pointer or
keyboard input when `editable`. The component commits visual order immediately without moving consumer-owned light
DOM. Applications persist the typed `reorder` result and may later reconcile their authored children.

With `swipeable`, an item also slides sideways to reveal the `swipe-actions` behind it (a red Delete by default):
tap an action or swipe past half the item's width to run the outermost one, and tap the item, swipe it back, press
Escape or tap elsewhere to close it again. A vertical drag still reorders; a horizontal one swipes.

Use `data-fixed` to pin an item at its absolute position, `data-reorder-key` for optional stable application
identity, and `data-reorder-label` for announcements. Non-empty keys must be unique. Editable lists need an
accessible name through `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or a `<label for>`. Whole-row touch reordering owns the vertical gesture;
interactive descendants retain their native behavior and never arm a reorder.

With `ranked`, each row shows its position in a `rank` badge. With a `name`, the list is a form control: it submits
the `data-reorder-key` of each keyed row in the displayed order, and `value` reads or sets that order (the `value`
attribute, keys separated by `;`, sets the initial one). When rows are added or removed, the list keeps the order the
user committed for the rows that stayed; only rows the light DOM itself moved return to its order.

members.name: editable
members.description: Enables pointer and keyboard reordering.

members.name: dropKind
members.description:
The kind of item payload the list takes from outside (another list, another window), as a source writes it with
`writeItemPayload(dataTransfer, kind, items)` from `@c2n/core/controllers/drop-zone.js` (MIME type
`application/x-c2n-<kind>+json`). Empty (the default) takes none. Needs `editable`. The list draws no rows of its
own: a drop fires `item-drop` with the place under the pointer, the application adds the rows there, and the list
announces how many were added. A drop not cancelled counts as taken, and a source with a `drag-kind` then lets its
items go. A drop whose `detail.items` no `item-drop` listener read during the event adds nothing (the list warns
once), so no item leaves its source for a list that never adds it: read it in the listener itself
(`const { items, before } = event.detail`), not later in a state updater or after an `await`.

members.name: dragKind
members.description:
The kind of item payload rows leave the list as, for a list, board or tree whose `drop-kind` is the same. Empty
(the default), rows stay in the list. Set, on an `editable` list: a pointer drag carried off the list drops the row
on the zone under the pointer that takes this kind; each movable row shows a drag handle (the `drag-handle` part)
whose drag the browser carries (dropped back on the list, it reorders the row; a drop outside c2n, in another window
too, is a copy); and `moveItemTo` moves a row from code, the keyboard path an
application wires to a command. A row is carried as `dragData` returns it, else as `{ id, label }`. The list
draws no rows of its own: when another place took one, `item-move-out` asks the application to remove it.

members.name: dragData
members.description: What a row carries when it leaves the list (`drag-kind`). Unset, `{ id, label }`: its `data-reorder-key` and label.

members.name: dragStartThreshold
members.description: Minimum summed pointer movement in CSS pixels before pickup. Invalid values use 10.

members.name: autoScrollDisabled
members.description: Prevents component-driven scrolling of the nearest eligible vertical ancestor.

members.name: swipeable
members.description: Lets users swipe an item sideways to reveal its swipe actions. Items with `data-swipe="false"` do not swipe.

members.name: swipeActions
members.description:
The actions a swipe reveals, as an array of `ReorderSwipeAction` (a JSON array in the attribute). The first action
of each side is the outermost one, which a full swipe runs. Defaults to a single red Delete on the end side.

members.name: ranked
members.description: Shows each row's position, from 1, in a `rank` badge before it.

members.name: renderRank
members.description: Draws the content of each `rank` badge of a `ranked` list instead of the position number.

members.name: name
members.description:
Form field name. With a name, the list submits the `data-reorder-key` of each keyed row, in the displayed order, as
one entry per row under it; rows without a key are not submitted.

members.name: value
members.description:
Puts the movable rows with these keys first, in this order, and the other movable rows after them in their current
order; fixed rows keep their positions and unknown keys are ignored. The light DOM is not moved. A value set before
the rows exist applies once they arrive. In markup, the `value` attribute lists the keys of the initial order
separated by `;` (`value="price;speed"`, or a JSON array when a key holds a `;`); a form reset returns to it.

members.name: form
members.description: The form this list is associated with, if any.

members.name: field
members.description: Names and describes the list inside a `c2-form-field`.

members.name: dropZone
members.default: new DropZoneController(this, { itemKind: () => this.dropKind, disabled: () => !this.reorderable || !!this.session, onItems: (drop) => this.receiveDrop(drop), onOwnDrop: ({ point }) => this.dropOwnRow(point), })

members.name: hydration
members.description:
A declarative shadow root was rendered on the server, which cannot see the light DOM, so it holds no items:
hydrate that empty list first, or Lit finds more items than markers and throws, and only then pick them up.

members.name: receiveDrop
members.description: Asks the application to add the rows of an item payload dropped on the list; returns how many it took.

members.name: manualSlots
members.description:
Whether slots are assigned by hand. False only when the shadow root came from declarative shadow DOM (server
rendering), which is always in named mode; the list then falls back to writing `slot` on its items.

members.name: getSpecialChildren
members.description: Children the author put in the `placeholder` or `dragging-item` slot, which manual assignment does not route.

members.name: onList
members.description: Whether a point is on the list, or within `margin` of it.

members.name: carryOut
members.description:
Off the list with a `drag-kind`: finds the zone under the pointer that takes the row and shows the drag over it.
Returns whether the drag is off the list, where the row's place in the list stays as it was. A zone under the
pointer wins over the list's own box, which also covers rows a scrolling ancestor hides.

members.name: dragOutOf
members.description: What rows carry when they leave the list, or `null` when the list lets none leave.

members.name: moveItemTo
members.description:
Moves a row to another list, board or tree whose `drop-kind` is the list's `drag-kind`, without a pointer: the
keyboard path to another instance, which an application wires to a command. The row lands at the target's natural
place (the end). Returns whether the row left the list: not when the list has no `drag-kind`, is not `editable`, no
row has that `data-reorder-key`, the target takes no such item, or a listener cancelled `item-move-out` (the
target then holds a copy). Otherwise the row has left: the application removes it on `item-move-out`.

members.name: moveOut
members.description: Tells the application which rows another place took, for it to remove them.

members.name: nativeDrag
members.description: The row being carried by the browser from its drag handle, and what it carries.

members.name: handleHandleDragStart
members.description: A row's drag handle: the browser carries the row, as JSON under the `drag-kind` and a line of text.

members.name: swallowNextClick
members.description: A pointer that swiped or closed an item must not also click what was under it.

members.name: commitOrder
members.description: Shows `nextOrder`, says so and fires `reorder`, `input` and `change`: the end of every reorder that changed it.

members.name: dropOwnRow
members.description: A row's drag handle dropped back on the list: the row moves to the drop point, as a pointer drag would put it.

members.name: getLabelElements
members.description:
The elements that name the list: those `aria-labelledby` lists, else the `<label for>`s pointing at it. A label that
wraps the list is left out, since it would read the rows too.

members.name: syncContainerName
members.description:
Names the `role=list` container. The label elements are referenced (`ariaLabelledByElements`), so the name follows
their text; a browser without element reflection gets their text as `aria-label`. Done after each render rather than
in the template, so a server-rendered list is named once it hydrates, and again whenever the host's naming
attributes or the labels' text change.

members.name: observeLabels
members.description: Watches the host's naming attributes and the label elements' text, which change the list's name.

members.name: keepDisplayedOrder
members.description:
The new authored rows with the rows that stayed in the order they were displayed in, when the light DOM only gained
or lost rows. When the remaining rows were themselves moved in the light DOM, that order wins as before.

members.name: fillMovable
members.description: `order` with its movable rows replaced, in turn, by `movable`; fixed rows keep their positions.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired after `reorder` when a user reorder changes `value`. Bubbles and crosses shadow boundaries.

events.name: item-drop
events.description: Fired when items of the `drop-kind` payload are dropped on the list from outside it. The application adds a row for each, before `detail.before`. Cancelable: `preventDefault()` announces them as not added. Does not bubble: each of `c2-kanban`, `c2-reorder-list` and `c2-tree` sends its own `detail`, so a drop on one nested in another must not reach the outer one's listeners. Listen on the element itself.

events.name: item-move-out
events.description: Fired when another place took rows of the `drag-kind` payload (a pointer drag carried off the list, the drag handle's drag ending in a move, or `moveItemTo`). The list draws no rows of its own: the application removes `detail.rows`; when no listener reads them during the event, they stay (a copy) and the list warns once. Cancelable, like the board's and the tree's: `preventDefault()` says the rows stay (a copy), and the list announces no move. Does not bubble.

events.name: swipe-action
events.description: Fired when a swipe action runs, from its button, a full swipe or its key. Bubbles, crosses shadow boundaries and is cancelable: the `delete` action removes the item unless the event is canceled.

events.name: reorder
events.description: Fired once after a real committed user reorder. Bubbles and crosses shadow boundaries; not cancelable.

events.name: change
events.description: Deprecated numeric permutation emitted with `reorder` during the compatibility window.

events.name: reorder-error
events.description: Fired when duplicate non-empty item keys prevent pickup.
